scientific_question: Can the frozen 1-D union relevant-object visible-area fraction be recovered from frozen natural-RGB features, optionally conditioned on the existing frozen task-language representation, with sufficient absolute fidelity and counterfactual decision signal?

frozen_upstream.language_contract: reuse the existing frozen task_metadata/language_features [10,512]; do not re-encode or tune language
frozen_upstream.transitive_ledger: The annotated upstream tag transitively freezes C0-v2, the C1-v2.1 candidate generator and production scale, D13/D14/D15, WM-v2A/B/B.1/C-EJ, the camera contract, natural RGB and CLIP features, per-object masks used as labels only, branch identities, and every prior mechanism report/result/checkpoint.

calibration.use: all input/model/epoch selection, feature normalization, tie threshold, downstream ridge CV and fit, and freezing

development_evaluation.use: one-shot frozen development evaluation, explicitly not blind confirmation

target.name: F1 relevant-object visible-area fraction
target.formula: pixel count in the union of the two runtime obj_of_interest natural segmentation masks divided by 128*128
target.mask_role: training/evaluation label only; never an extractor input

inputs.E0_visual: natural RGB-derived frozen visual feature only
inputs.E1_visual_language: the same visual feature concatenated with the existing frozen 512-D task-language feature
inputs.V0_global: full natural-image frozen global CLIP projection [512]
inputs.V1_patch_mean: unweighted arithmetic mean of the 49 frozen natural CLIP patch-token projections [512], with no post-mean L2 normalization
inputs.forbidden_inputs: segmentation masks, depth, simulator state, proprioception, object pose, EE pose, contact, future action, candidate identity, future simulator state, masked/cropped/object-only image inference

models.M1_linear: standardized input -> Linear(d,1); inverse target standardization; fixed clamp to [0,1]
models.M2_mlp: standardized input -> Linear(d,64)-GELU-Linear(64,32)-GELU-Linear(32,1); inverse target standardization; fixed clamp to [0,1]
models.loss: unweighted mean squared error on raw area fraction
models.epoch_selection: within each candidate, leave-one-init-state-out validation chooses minimum MAE epoch; final epoch is round-half-up median of four best epochs
models.normalization: featurewise calibration-only mean/std; columns below 1e-8 std use scale one; area target uses the training fold mean/std, is inverted at prediction, and is then clamped to [0,1]

calibration_preflight_correction_history.phase: after the first calibration invocation and before any init36-39 access
calibration_preflight_correction_history.issue: A sigmoid output initialized near 0.5 remained far outside the approximately 0.026 target scale, making the linear baseline an optimization nonstarter rather than a meaningful extractor.
calibration_preflight_correction_history.correction: Standardize the area target using each calibration training fold, use an unconstrained scalar head, invert the standardization, and apply a preregistered fixed [0,1] clamp.
calibration_preflight_correction_history.unchanged: natural features, language representation, E0/E1 and V0/V1 candidates, M1/M2 widths and parameter ceilings, MSE loss, optimizer, epochs, split, OOF selection order, tie formula, downstream probes, bootstrap, shuffle, numeric gates, labels, and authorizations

selection.per_condition: select exactly one of V0/V1 x M1/M2 separately for E0 and E1
lexicographic_order: lowest calibration OOF signed pair-difference RMSE
largest calibration OOF downstream Area RMSE improvement
selection.evaluation_role: all eight frozen models are reported, but only the two calibration-selected condition representatives enter authorization
selection.language_rule: if E0 passes the complete frozen gate, select E0 even when E1 also passes; language is needed only when E1 passes and E0 fails

candidate_differential.signed_difference: A_i-A_j in canonical A0-A1, A0-A2, A1-A2 order
candidate_differential.tie_rule: freeze the 10th percentile of strictly positive absolute calibration pair differences; omit rows at or below it only from direction accuracy
candidate_differential.ordering: per branch/horizon mean three-way Spearman, pairwise ordering accuracy, maximum-area agreement, and minimum-area agreement
candidate_differential.scale_control: compare candidate mean absolute separation divided by adjacent-horizon temporal movement in predicted and real area coordinates

downstream.pair_summary: the exact frozen six-slot F1 summary: absolute scalar difference repeated in RMSE/MAE/max/top-quartile/scale slots with centroid slot zero
downstream.selection: leave-one-init-state-out CV on init31-34; exact ties favor larger alpha
primary_targets: frozen Area residual after calibration EE-only control
secondary_targets: frozen ObjMask residual after calibration EE-only control

shuffle.rule: derange the complete six-dimensional predicted-area summary across branch points within identical task, horizon, and candidate pair while G and target remain fixed

bootstrap.unit: task-stratified matched branch point retaining all 24 candidate-image or pair/horizon rows

gates.dynamic_range_rule: both std(predicted image area)/std(real image area) and std(predicted pair delta)/std(real pair delta) must be at least 0.25
gates.complete_gate: absolute MAE improvement >=20 percent with CI lower >0; downstream Area gain >=10 percent with CI lower >0; predicted-area shuffle CI lower >0; Area-residual gain >=5 percent with CI lower >0; positive on >=7 tasks, >=4 horizons, and all three pairs; no image or pair dynamic-range collapse

decision.go_scope: permits only a separately preregistered seed11 single-model offline action-conditioned future-visible-area World Model prototype; no reranker, score redesign, controller, reward, success, seed23/47, or init40-49

forbidden: Do not train a World Model, GRU, Transformer, action-conditioned model, actor, candidate generator, reranker, score, or controller.
Do not run C1/C2, D20-v2, seed23/47, reward, done, success, final task outcome, controller rollout, or init40-49.
Do not select or fine-tune an encoder; do not use SAM, DINO, SigLIP, CNN, a large decoder, masked RGB, cropped RGB, or object-only inference.
Do not use masks, depth, state, proprioception, object/EE pose, contact, future action, candidate ID, or future simulator state as extractor inputs.
Do not reconstruct the 49-D soft footprint, redesign F1, tune any form on init36-39, or overwrite upstream artifacts.
